integrity: Exact generator and semigroup proof; numerical tests are supplementary diagnostics and not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires two independent Gaussian thermal coordinates, positive harmonic relaxation, common Poisson shocks with one deterministic multiplicative factor, stationary observation. Does not establish inverse consistency under measurement errors, finite-sample efficiency, or priority over unindexed equivalent formulas.
title: A fourth-order time arrow and exact shock inversion in synchronously reset harmonic diffusion
